facts.fact: Telecom Egypt's brochure states it owns and operates six commercial data center facilities at diverse locations in Egypt, serving ISPs, cloud/OTT, enterprise, government cloud and international operators (as_of is the brochure's date; it gives none).
Telecom Egypt's Regional Data Hub (RDH) at Smart Village, Cairo, an open-access data center, was commissioned in 2021 (Building 1, 400 racks/2.5MW, ready for service 2021).
facts.system: Telecom Egypt Regional Data Hub (RDH), Smart Village

facts.fact: Telecom Egypt's brochure states the RDH data center at Smart Village holds Tier III certification of design, facility and operation from the Uptime Institute (certification date not given; as_of is the brochure's date).
facts.system: Telecom Egypt Regional Data Hub (RDH), Smart Village

note: RDH Buildings 2 to 4 are under construction or TBA, not facts.
